composeInputEvidence.purpose: Preserve the exact order of repeated ordinary Compose inputs and retain the original limit of sixteen distinct protected files. Keep managed override position and effective model checks.

composeReferenceEvidence.purpose: Admit only bounded block anchor definitions and whole mapping-value aliases. Keep YAML merge keys, indirect external files, nested references and other unsupported syntax closed.

composeInlineAnchorEvidence.purpose: Admit a bounded literal scalar after a mapping-value anchor on the same line. Continue rejecting external file aliases, malformed reference positions and multiline anchor scalars.

composeInlineInterpolationEvidence.purpose: Admit bounded Compose variable substitutions in an inline anchored plain scalar while preserving the external-input, renderer equality and rollback guards.

composeSquareBracketEvidence.purpose: Admit bounded literal bracketed values and single-line scalar lists while preserving the external-input, renderer equality and rollback guards.
